episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: A contractor who starts spending more time with his three kids when his wife, Andi, goes back to work and discovers the truth all parents eventually realize - their little angels are maniacs.

episodes.title: Two Tickets to Paradise
episodes.summary: Adam gets tickets to a Steelers game and debates who he should take: his wife or his brother.

episodes.title: The Puppet Theater
episodes.summary: When Adam gets fed up with endless demands from his daughter's kindergarten teacher, Mrs. Rodriguez, he makes a hasty decision that lands him in hot water with his wife Andi.

episodes.title: Un-Dressed
episodes.summary: When Don encourages Adam to clean out his cluttered garage and turn it into a man cave, Adam panics when he thinks he donated one of Andi's treasured keepsakes.

episodes.title: Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: Andi has a hard time not taking over when Adam tackles organizing the school's big Thanksgiving feast with Don and Lowell.

episodes.title: Holey War
episodes.summary: When the kids won't admit who put a hole in the wall, Adam and Andi team up to get the culprit to confess.

episodes.title: Winter Has Come
episodes.summary: When a blizzard prevents the Burns family from visiting the grandparents' house for Christmas, Adam and Andi scramble to avoid an epic holiday disaster.

episodes.title: Adam Steps Up
episodes.summary: When Adam's oldest daughter experiences a momentous occasion while Andi is unavailable, he tries to keep his cool and gingerly guide her through it. Also, Andi takes Emme and Teddy to the zoo, but instead gets stuck in traffic along with Emme's annoying talking toy.

episodes.title: What About Bob?
episodes.summary: Adam tries to pretend he isn't jealous when he discovers Andi has a close male friend at work.

episodes.title: A Dinner Gone Wrong
episodes.summary: When Andi and Marcy realize they were rivals in high school, Adam and Don are dragged into the feud and forced to take sides.

episodes.title: The Talk
episodes.summary: When Adam and Andi have the dreaded "talk" with Teddy and Kate, their awkward approach makes the kids horribly uncomfortable.

episodes.title: The Three Amigos
episodes.summary: When Andi forces Adam to hang out with Lowell, Don feels left out and Andi has to make peace between them. Also, Mrs. Rodriguez reveals to Andi that she had a sexy dream about Adam.

episodes.title: Valentine's Day
episodes.summary: When Adam and Andi's babysitter cancels on Valentine's Day, they try to survive leaving Kate in charge at home for the first time. Also, Don forgets to make romantic plans for Marcy and tries to steal Adam's.

episodes.title: Kate's First Date
episodes.summary: When Kate is asked out on her first date, Adam can't curb his overprotective ways. Also, Don enlists Lowell's help to buy the perfect anniversary gift for Marcy.

episodes.title: Assisted Living
episodes.summary: When Adam's parents visit unannounced, they reveal surprising plans for their future living arrangements.

episodes.title: The A Team
episodes.summary: Adam and Andi are shocked when they finally meet Lowell's wife.

episodes.title: Doctor No
episodes.summary: When Adam convinces his stubborn father to finally go to the doctor, he learns a few things his dad didn't want him to know.

episodes.title: The Blame Game
episodes.summary: Adam and Don discover a sneaky way of getting out of trouble with their wives.

episodes.title: Spring Fling
episodes.summary: When a client doesn't want Don to attend a big meeting, Adam goes to great lengths to protect his brother's feelings. Also, Andi kisses up to Mrs. Rodriguez to ensure Emme gets the best teacher for first grade.

episodes.title: Dirty Money
episodes.summary: When Adam and Andi borrow money from Joe to help with a cash flow problem, they soon regret it.

episodes.title: Operation False Freedom
episodes.summary: When Adam and Andi discover Kate is lying to them about her whereabouts, they hatch a plan to catch her.

episodes.title: Buzzer Beater
episodes.summary: Adam and Andi toy with having another baby when Don and Marcy's newborn grandson comes for a visit.

episodes.title: The Silver Fox
episodes.summary: Andi hires a pretty, young babysitter, Sophia, to watch the kids, and gets jealous when her daughter, Kate, goes to her instead for advice. Also, Sophia tells Adam she has the hots for him.

episodes.title: Andi's Boyfriend
episodes.summary: When Adam discovers that the pastor he hired for their wedding was a phony and he and Andi aren't really married, he scrambles to find a way to fix it before she finds out.

episodes.title: The Parents Strike Back
episodes.summary: When the kids won't do their chores, Adam and Andi decide to go on strike too.

episodes.title: Into the Weeds
episodes.summary: When Adam thinks Kate's boyfriend, Tyler, is a pothead, he decides to confront Tyler but doesn't get the support he expects from Andi. Also, Don tells Lowell there are office "rules" he must follow, but Lowell suspects he is making it up and threatens to bring in Adam to confirm the policies.

episodes.title: Battle of the Sexists
episodes.summary: When Adam needs to hire a new project manager, Andi accuses Adam of unconscious bias after he only interviews men for the job. Also, Andi helps Kate fight for a spot on the boys' soccer team at school.

episodes.title: Adam Gets Neighborly
episodes.summary: Adam and Andi try to get back in their neighbors' good graces after no one shows up to their potluck.

episodes.title: We Can Be Heroes
episodes.summary: When Adam and Andi are caught off guard by unexpected expenses, they each decide to give up a luxury to pay them off.

episodes.title: Lice Lice Baby
episodes.summary: When Adam takes his kids to work with him for the day, they accidentally give his biggest client lice. Also, Andi feels like a bad mom when she's the only one in the family not to get lice.

episodes.title: The Gunfight
episodes.summary: When Adam notices his Dad's increasingly forgetful behavior, he struggles with how to approach him to discuss it.

episodes.title: Adam's Turtle-y Awesome Valentine's Day
episodes.summary: When Adam and Andi agree on a present-free Valentine's Day, Adam gives the gift he planned for Andi to his mother instead.

episodes.title: Guess Who's Coming to Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner
episodes.summary: When Andi gets Bev a spot volunteering at the hospital, Joe becomes bored and starts spending too much time with Adam.

episodes.title: Everybody's a Winner
episodes.summary: When Andi and Adam disagree about Kate attending a dance with an older boy, Adam tries to outsmart Andi to win the argument.

episodes.title: The Party Planner
episodes.summary: Adam attempts to organize a birthday dinner for Andi and he discovers that managing guests isn't easy.

episodes.title: March Madness
episodes.summary: When Adam and Andi lose footage of an intimate moment they accidentally recorded, they have to track it down before anyone can see it.

episodes.title: Out with the In-laws
episodes.summary: When Andi's folks decide to visit them for Easter, Adam and Andi have to keep the peace between both sets of parents.

episodes.title: April Fools
episodes.summary: When Adam insists that pranks are harmless fun, Andi creates an elaborate hoax to teach him a lesson.

episodes.title: King for a Day
episodes.summary: Adam is determined to figure out what Andi's hiding when he discovers she's been keeping secrets from him for his own good.

episodes.title: The Burns System
episodes.summary: Adam is thrilled and honored to help Joe buy a new car but is caught off guard when Joe suddenly becomes irritable and the negotiations go off track. Also, Andi discovers Emme has been hiding a pet snake and has to figure out a way to get rid of it.

episodes.title: We Hate Money
episodes.summary: When Adam and Don realize they need to bring in more business, they film a commercial advertising their company. Also, Andi works up the courage to ask her boss, Bob, for a raise.

episodes.title: We Got a Girl
episodes.summary: Adam and Andi set up Adam's boss on a date to boost her spirits in the hope that she'll then be in the mood to have Adam resume work on the mini-mall.

episodes.title: Family Business
episodes.summary: After struggling to find work, Andi proposes an idea for her and Adam to go into business together. Also, Adam tackles a challenging renovation of Joe and Bev's kitchen.

episodes.title: Wife-Proof
episodes.summary: Adam attempts to make the office feel more inviting since Andi will be joining him at work every day. Also, Lowell has been hiding a life-changing secret.

episodes.title: Yeah, Maybe
episodes.summary: When Adam and Andi have a disagreement at the office, they must find a way to solve it so it doesn't become a problem at home. Also, the kids try to extend Lowell's stay at their house after realizing he's an amazing cook.

episodes.title: Put Him on the Ground
episodes.summary: When Adam sees a kid push Emme, he convinces Teddy to dish out some old-school justice to defend his younger sister, to Andi's dismay. Also, Adam and Don persuade Joe to hire a nurse to help out after his upcoming knee surgery.

episodes.title: Adam's Wall Hole Bowl
episodes.summary: Adam and the guys visit Lowell at his new bachelor pad and start using it as a hangout to get away from their home lives for a bit. Also, Andi keeps pushing Adam to finally give her own desk at the office.

episodes.title: The New Old School
episodes.summary: When Adam catches Kate sneaking back into the house at night, he is determined to fix the behavior with old-school parenting tactics. Also, Andi is dismayed when she can't find many baby pictures of Emme.

episodes.title: Semi-Indecent Proposal
episodes.summary: Adam and Andi go to great lengths to secure a loan to fix an unexpected issue on their flip house. Also, Joe is enjoying hanging out with his nurse, Funches, and wants to find a way to get him to stay with him longer than planned.

episodes.title: Hotel Hanky Panky
episodes.summary: Adam and Andi are eager to book a night away in a hotel after Teddy keeps sleeping in their bed. Also, Kate is allowed to stay home alone but doesn't follow Adam and Andi's strict rules.

episodes.title: Adam's Ribs
episodes.summary: When Adam offers to eat a vegan diet with Kate in an effort to bond with her, his love of meat proves a hard habit to break.

episodes.title: Adam Acts His Age
episodes.summary: After Adam throws out his back on his 50th birthday, he is still determined to take a dirt bike excursion and check it off his bucket list. Also, Don and Adam give out bonuses at work and everyone tries to figure out how to spend them.

episodes.title: We Don't Need Another Hero
episodes.summary: Adam gets jealous when Teddy names Andi as his hero for a school essay.

episodes.title: Cabin Fever
episodes.summary: When Adam accidentally invites Andi on the annual guys' trip, he tries to un-invite her, which only makes matters worse.

episodes.title: Clean Country Living
episodes.summary: Adam recruits Marcy to put Andi's snooty sister, Kelly, in her place when she comes for a visit.

episodes.title: The Intervention(s)
episodes.summary: When Adam and Andi see how much Lowell's new relationship with Andi's sister, Kelly, is changing him, they stage an intervention to get him to stop putting up with her bad behavior.

episodes.title: The V-Word
episodes.summary: When Andi's doctor advises her to stop taking birth control pills, Adam and Andi disagree on an alternate option.

episodes.title: Adam's Big Little Lie
episodes.summary: Adam promises not to lie to Andi again but finds himself in a tough spot when he has to cover for Joe.

episodes.title: The Ex Files
episodes.summary: Adam and Don become super protective of Lowell when they think he might get back together with his cheating ex-wife. Also, Joe experiences an unexpected side effect from his new pacemaker that Bev is less than thrilled with.

episodes.title: Going All the Way
episodes.summary: Adam and Andi offer Teddy dating advice but wind up making things super awkward for him instead.

episodes.title: Winner Winner Chicken Salad
episodes.summary: Adam encourages Don to give himself food poisoning to get out of babysitting his destructive grandson. Also, Adam and Andi argue over who has to take Kate and her teenage friends dress shopping

episodes.title: Couples Therapy
episodes.summary: When Adam buys a boat without asking Andi, they wind up in couple's therapy to settle the disagreement.

episodes.title: Dude, Where's My Boat?
episodes.summary: Adam discovers someone is sneaking his boat out at night, and he assumes the culprits are Don and Joe. Also, after Andi makes Kate get a job at the mall, Kate decides she no longer wants to go to college.

episodes.title: Adam's Not Sorry
episodes.summary: When Adam and Don disagree about a new house to flip for their construction business, their bickering reveals bigger issues in their relationship. Also, Andi goes to great lengths to throw the perfect birthday party for Bev.

episodes.title: Stuck in the Middle with You
episodes.summary: Adam's mother-in-law, Alice, makes an unexpected visit and reveals some shocking news.

episodes.title: Full Metal Teddy
episodes.summary: When Adam and Andi resort to their usual punishment in response to Teddy's bad grades, his unexpected reaction catches them off guard

episodes.title: Adam and Andi See Other People
episodes.summary: Adam and Andi attempt to spice up their social life by making new friends.

episodes.title: Driving Miss Katie
episodes.summary: Adam has trouble helping Katie prepare for her driving test. Also, Don turns to Lowell for help romancing Marcy.

episodes.title: Happy Ann-RV-sary
episodes.summary: Adam tries to give Andi the perfect 20th wedding anniversary gift by recreating their honeymoon.
